periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis of the eye patches is angled approximately 60 degrees downward toward the rostrum relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology; the longitudinal axis of the patch is approximately 1.7 times the width of the transverse axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering is observed, with the lowest point of the patch being distal to the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: The posterior margin of the dark band across the shoulders displays a shallow, wide U-shape profile.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark transverse band occupies approximately 35% of the visible upper torso vertical height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Ears are positioned with a wide lateral gap, separated by a distance roughly equivalent to the width of the upper cranium.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Non-uniform curvature; the superior edges of the ears exhibit a slight flattening at the apex rather than a perfect semicircular arc.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant chromatic shift on the abdominal fur, which appears brownish-tan in contrast to the white fur on the head.
